name: vitest-native
description: Run real React Native tests under Vitest. One install, zero config.
author: Daniel Fry

scripts.test:native: node scripts/run-scripts.mjs test:native:no-globals test:native:main test:native:rntl-timers test:native:one-instance test:native:context test:native:shared-root test:native:preset-modules test:native:permissive test:native:reanimated-fallback test:native:partial-mock-external test:native:tsconfig-paths test:native:regex-alias test:native:dispatch-alias test:native:jest-registry-node-mocks test:native:node-mocks test:native:root-mocks test:native:ownership
scripts.test:native:root-mocks: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.root-mocks.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.root-mocks.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.root-mocks-projects.config.mts
scripts.test:native:one-instance: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.one-instance.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.one-instance.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.one-instance.config.mts --mode early && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.one-instance.config.mts --mode jest-compat
scripts.test:native:rntl-timers: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.rntl-timers.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.rntl-timers.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.rntl-timers.config.mts --mode setup-stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.rntl-timers.config.mts --mode setup-hot
scripts.test:native:ownership: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.ownership.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.ownership.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.ownership.config.mts --mode shadow && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.ownership.config.mts --mode resolution && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.ownership.config.mts --mode resolution-hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.regex-alias.config.mts --mode ownership && node scripts/test-ownership-control.mjs && node scripts/test-ownership-registry-reuse.mjs
scripts.test:native:context: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.context.config.mts && node --conditions=vn-probe node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config tests-native/vitest.context.config.mts --project threads
scripts.test:native:no-globals: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode native && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode noiso && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode mock-noiso && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode noiso-fakes-setup && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode noiso-fakes-leak && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode mock-noiso-fakes-setup && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.no-globals.config.mts --mode mock-noiso-fakes-leak
scripts.test:native:node-mocks: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.node-mocks.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.node-mocks.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.node-mocks.config.mts --mode jest-compat
scripts.test:native:shared-root: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.shared-root.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.shared-root.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.shared-root-extends.config.mts
scripts.test:native:reanimated-fallback: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.reanimated-fallback.config.mts --mode native && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.reanimated-fallback.config.mts --mode hot
scripts.test:native:preset-modules: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.custom-preset.config.mts --mode native && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.custom-preset.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.custom-preset.config.mts --mode mock
scripts.test:native:permissive: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.permissive.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.permissive.config.mts --mode hot
scripts.test:native:hot:isolation: vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.hot-isolation.config.mts && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.hot-user-setup.config.mts && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.hot-jest-compat.config.mts --mode stock && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.hot-jest-compat.config.mts --mode hot && vitest run --config tests-native/vitest.jest-registry-no-isolate.config.mts && bun run test:native:hot:file-accounting && bun run test:native:hot:act-scope && bun run test:native:hot:rntl-optout && bun run test:native:hot:compile-cache && bun run test:native:hot:workspace-member && bun run test:native:hot:memory && bun run test:native:hot:generation-parity
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src/ tests/ tests-native/ crosscheck/ consumer-tests/ scripts/
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check:size && bun run test && bun run test:native && bun run test:native:forks && bun run test:native:navigation && bun run test:native:android && bun run test:native:advice && bun run test:native:hot && bun run test:native:hot:isolation && bun run test:native:hot:state-manifest && bun run test:native:hot:soak && bun run validate:hot-parity && bun run validate:registry-process && bun run fidelity:check && bun run test:consumers && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
